title: Company OKR Convergence Canvas and Initiative Tagging System
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose:
Create a lightweight, operational "Convergence Canvas" and a standardized initiative tagging schema to make company-level OKRs and downstream initiatives discoverable, measurable, and automatable across Product, Eng, Design, and GTM. The Canvas will be a single-plane artifact that surfaces (1) company OKR(s), (2) initiative clusters that map to each objective, (3) owner and cross-team leads, (4) explicit dependencies and risk signals, and (5) escalation thresholds. The tagging system will be implemented in Linear (custom fields + labels) and mirrored in Confluence & Looker dashboards so teams can filter and roll up progress by OKR, pillar, horizon, and risk level.

Scope:
- Design Convergence Canvas template and acceptance criteria for adoption
- Define initiative tagging taxonomy (objective_id, pillar, owner_role, priority_lane, risk_level, capacity_bucket) and mapping rules
- Implement Linear custom fields + label conventions and a short UX guide for PMs
- Build a Confluence canonical page and migration plan for existing initiatives
- Ship a Looker/Sheets rollup that shows initiative count, RAG, and percent complete by objective

Out of scope:
- Full automation of cross-team resourcing (follow-up OKR automation spike)
- Changes to compensation or incentive structures tied to OKRs

Goals / Success metrics:
- 90% of new company initiatives tagged with taxonomy within 2 sprints of pilot launch
- 95% of cross-functional leads can locate the relevant Convergence Canvas entry within 3 clicks
- Rollup dashboard surfaces OKR progress with <24h freshness and is used in weekly leadership syncs
- Reduction in cross-team coordination tickets labeled "OKR-mismatch" by 40% in Q2 compared to Q1

Acceptance criteria:
- Convergence Canvas template reviewed and approved by CEO, Head of Product, Head of Eng, and Head of Design (sign-off recorded in Confluence)
- Linear custom fields created and validated with sample initiatives (>=6 pilot initiatives across 4 teams)
- Looker dashboard demonstrates correct rollups for objective->initiative mapping with test dataset
- Onboarding doc + 15-minute training recorded and published

Stakeholders:
- Executive sponsor: Maya Rios (COO)
- Product lead: Aisha Patel (creator)
- PM rollout lead: Sofia Zhang (assignee)
- Eng liaison: Luis Martinez
- Design liaison: Priya Kapoor

Rollout plan (high level):
1) Week 1: Finalize taxonomy & Canvas (workshop with cross-functional leads)
2) Week 2: Implement Linear custom fields + Confluence template, build Looker prototype
3) Week 3-4: Pilot with 6 initiatives (2 platform, 2 product, 2 infra) and collect feedback
4) Week 5: Iterate and prepare org-wide launch materials
5) Week 6: Launch and host leadership demo; start weekly adoption tracking

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Teams may resist additional tagging work -> Mitigation: keep taxonomy intentionally small, provide one-click label templates, and integrate tagging into PRD checklist
- Risk: Looker data lag or schema mismatch -> Mitigation: initial rollout uses a verified nightly sync and a manual reconciliation step during pilot

Dependencies:
- Linear schema update (ENG-1842) for enabling custom fields
- Looker data model change owned by Analytics team (AN-3021)
- Migration of legacy initiatives documented in Confluence (content owners: platform/product managers)
